questions.question: What did David charge Solomon to do before he died?
options: Build a great navy on the Red Sea
Walk in God's ways and keep his commands
March out and conquer all the land of Egypt
Make a treaty with the king of Egypt
questions.answer: Walk in God's ways and keep his commands

questions.question: What happened to Adonijah, Joab, and Shimei under Solomon?
options: They fled to a foreign land
